about: Playground-only planted-bug cases for the JaagteRaho Live playground. They are NOT part of the published JR-Bench numbers (those are computed on bench/cases.json only). Same format as cases.json: each bug is planted into a clean generated app (inject: exact find/replace, optional clean_inject), 'trigger' runs in the app folder and must raise, and 'test' is a hidden test that must pass on the clean app and fail on the broken one, accepting any sensible fix (a clear 4xx answer or success).

cases.story: A commit dropped the int() around plates; the hostel form posts plates as text, and the check in the model blows up.
cases.trigger:
from messmenu.app import handle
handle('POST', '/api/meals', {'title': 'Poha', 'price': '30', 'served_on': '2026-11-14', 'plates': '150'})
cases.test:
import unittest
from messmenu.app import handle

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_plates_as_text(self):
        r = handle('POST', '/api/meals', {'title': 'Poha', 'price': '30', 'served_on': '2026-11-14', 'plates': '150'})
        self.assertIn(r['status'], (201, 400))
        r = handle('POST', '/api/meals', {'title': 'Idli', 'price': '40', 'served_on': '2026-11-14', 'plates': 80})
        self.assertEqual(r['status'], 201)
